SPIFF Zenodo Upload Bundle
==========================

Version: QR2-2026-04-24
Prepared: 2026-04-24

This upload bundle is intended to be published as a new version of the existing SPIFF Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.19051216.
The file set has been bundled to remain comfortably within Zenodo's current 100-file and 50 GB per-record limits.
This Zenodo bundle intentionally excludes the AAS Data Behind the Figures ZIPs and AAS figure-set ZIPs.
The autotype PNG bundles are organized by science sample and exclude the bad and snr classification subdirectories.

Current science-count snapshot represented by the package:
- High-quality spectra snapshot: 6003
- Known ultracool dwarfs: 2050
- Known photometric candidates: 3008
- Newly identified ultracool dwarfs: 947
- Special-spectrum objects: 3739
- Published standard subtypes: 47

Upload payload files: 15
Total payload size: 6.3GB (6721703066 bytes)

Payload inventory:
- spiff_tables.zip: tables; 14 packaged members; 766.5KB
- spiff_templates_hybrid_csv.zip: hybrid_template_csv; 47 packaged members; 79.4KB
- spiff_templates_raw_csv.zip: raw_template_csv; 44 packaged members; 74.1KB
- spiff_known_bds_binned_csv.zip: binned_csv; 2304 packaged members; 7.1MB
- spiff_known_bds_unbinned_csv.zip: unbinned_csv; 2304 packaged members; 234.3MB
- spiff_known_bds_autotype_png.zip: autotype_png; 2304 packaged members; 620.4MB
- spiff_photo_known_bds_binned_csv.zip: binned_csv; 8169 packaged members; 25.4MB
- spiff_photo_known_bds_unbinned_csv.zip: unbinned_csv; 8167 packaged members; 976.5MB
- spiff_photo_known_bds_autotype_png.zip: autotype_png; 8169 packaged members; 2.0GB
- spiff_new_bds_binned_csv.zip: binned_csv; 2028 packaged members; 6.3MB
- spiff_new_bds_unbinned_csv.zip: unbinned_csv; 2028 packaged members; 240.9MB
- spiff_new_bds_autotype_png.zip: autotype_png; 2025 packaged members; 539.9MB
- spiff_new_candidate_bds_binned_csv.zip: binned_csv; 4416 packaged members; 13.8MB
- spiff_new_candidate_bds_unbinned_csv.zip: unbinned_csv; 4415 packaged members; 488.7MB
- spiff_new_candidate_bds_autotype_png.zip: autotype_png; 4415 packaged members; 1.1GB

A machine-readable checksum manifest is provided in spiff_zenodo_manifest.csv.
Zenodo helper metadata for the draft deposit is stored outside this upload directory in the local zenodo_submission workspace folder.
